parameters.query: SELECT c.id, c.email, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.company, c.job_title, c.phone, c.lead_score, c.lead_status, c.source, c.created_at::date as created_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id) as total_activities, (SELECT MAX(la.created_at)::date FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id) as last_activity_date FROM contacts c WHERE c.updated_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '6 hours' OR c.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '6 hours' ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC LIMIT 500
